scope: Standing Victoria High School at 1260 Grant Street, including the restored original school, 1955 and 2011 attachments, and the 2024 additions within the mapped building envelope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The original account records the south Grant Street frontage, E-plan with three rear wings, four main floors, pressed brick and terracotta trim.
The school district records preservation of terracotta, granite and brick masonry, renovation and subsequent expansion.
The project architect documents the 2024 seismic retrofit and addition to the standing landmark.
The district distinguishes the original main building, the Andrews Gym addition and the later Fairey Tech Wing.
The heritage statement establishes Ionic forms, granite stairs, arched side window heads, and the northeast and northwest 2024 circulation additions. Text only.
The province records completion of the school expansion in 2024.

imageryReview.notes: Checked the Qualla story imagery first. The actual school views require attribution and its public-domain images depict other sites. The original 1912 newspaper page qualifies through the issue date and the archive’s public-domain record. It establishes the historic frontage. Modern changes use documented factual descriptions and the current map.
